What is TEZU?
TEZU is a creative studio with three tools: Character Creator, Image Generator and Video Generator.
What can I create with TEZU?
Character reference sheets, original images, and short cinematic video clips.
Do I need AI experience?
No. You describe what you want in plain words, and TEZU handles the technical prompt for you.
How does Character Creator work?
Choose Boy or Girl, describe your character in a sentence, and TEZU creates one reference sheet showing the character from several angles.
Can I reuse my characters?
Characters are saved to your private library. Using them as references inside Image and Video Studio is being rolled out during launch testing; results can still vary between scenes.
How do credits work?
Each creation shows its credit cost before you press Generate. Credits are only used when you generate, never for typing a prompt.
How long can my videos be?
Video Studio currently offers 5, 10 and 15 second clips. Longer clips will be added once they've been tested.
Can I download my images and videos?
Yes. Finished creations are stored privately in your library and can be downloaded.
What happens if a generation fails?
The credits reserved for that creation are returned automatically.
Can I use my creations commercially?
Commercial usage terms will be published before paid plans launch.
How do I cancel my subscription?
Paid plans aren't open yet, so there's nothing to cancel. Cancellation details will be shown before checkout opens.
How do I contact support?
Message us on Instagram at @nateassets or use the contact form on our Hire page.
